scanNote:
MUNDARIJA - O'NG BET (3-bet). Sarlavha yo'q: bu 2-betdagi jadvalning DAVOMI.

Uchta ustun (to'q yashil sarlavha yo'lakchalari):
• LISTENING & SPEAKING
• COMMUNICATION
• WRITING

Qatorlar 2-betdagi unit qatorlari bilan BIR SATRDA turadi va o'sha ranglarda. Hikoya (STORY) va MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT qatorlarining o'rni bo'sh - ular uchun bu ustunlar to'ldirilmagan.

Har unit qatoridagi 'Pronunciation:' yozuvi LISTENING & SPEAKING ustunining oxirida turadi.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '3'.

⚠ Bu bet mundarijaning o'ng yarmi - uni 2-bet bilan BIRGA o'qish kerak.

exercises.instructionUz: Mundarija - TINGLASH VA GAPIRISH, MULOQOT, YOZISH ustunlari.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - MUNDARIJANING O'NG YARMI (3-bet).

  Sarlavha yo'q, chunki bu 2-betdagi
  JADVALNING DAVOMI.


UChTA USTUN:

  LISTENING & SPEAKING
     = tinglash va gapirish

  COMMUNICATION
     = muloqot (nutq vazifalari)

  WRITING
     = yozish

  ⚠ 2-betdagi ustunlar bilan birga
  OLTITA bo'ladi:
     GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING,
     LISTENING & SPEAKING,
     COMMUNICATION, WRITING


⚠ TO'RT KO'NIKMA - IKKI GURUH:

  RECEPTIVE (qabul qiluvchi):
     reading  - o'qish
     listening - tinglash

  PRODUCTIVE (faol, o'zi hosil qiladigan):
     speaking - gapirish
     writing  - yozish

  ⚠ Kitob har unitda TO'RTALASINI ham
  mashq qildiradi.


⚠ 'PRONUNCIATION' HAR QATORDA:

  Har unitning LISTENING & SPEAKING
  ustuni oxirida 'Pronunciation:'
  yozuvi bor.

  = TALAFFUZ mashqi.

  Kitob bo'yicha talaffuz mavzulari:
     1  similar sounds - o'xshash tovushlar
     2  silent letters - o'qilmaydigan harflar
     3  /h/ tovushi
     4  sentence stress - gap urg'usi
     5  'll qisqartmasi
     6  like / 'd like farqi
     7  /id/ tovushi
     8  /o:/ - /o/ farqi
     9  word stress - so'z urg'usi
     10 must/mustn't
     11 /e/ tovushi (schwa)
     12 words that rhyme - qofiyalanuvchi so'zlar
     13 syllable stress - bo'g'in urg'usi
     14 Intonation - ohang
     15 Intonation in question tags

  ⚠ 'to pronounce' = talaffuz qilmoq
     → 'pronunciation' = talaffuz
  ⚠ DIQQAT: fe'lda 'nounce', otda
  'nunci' - imlo O'ZGARADI. Bu -
  ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan so'zlardan biri.


⚠ HAR UNITDA 'PROJECT' BOR:

  WRITING ustunida har qatorda
  'Project - ...' yozuvi bor.

  = uyga katta yozma ish.

  ⚠ 'a project' = loyiha, katta ish.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  listening     = tinglash
  speaking      = gapirish
  communication = muloqot
  writing       = yozish
  pronunciation = talaffuz
  to pronounce  = talaffuz qilmoq
  stress        = urg'u
  a syllable    = bo'g'in
  intonation    = ohang
  to rhyme      = qofiyalanmoq
  a project     = loyiha
  a leaflet     = varaqa, buklet
  a report      = hisobot, xabar

points.en: UNIT 1: talking about members of your family; describing people's character/appearance. Pronunciation: similar sounds
points.uz: 1-UNIT: oila a'zolari haqida gapirish; xarakter/tashqi qiyofani tasvirlash. Talaffuz: o'xshash tovushlar
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: welcoming people = odamlarni kutib olish
Yozish: Project - do'stga xat (dam olish maskani
  haqida); mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola

points.en: UNIT 2: talking about a school timetable; talking about people's daily routines. Pronunciation: silent letters
points.uz: 2-UNIT: maktab jadvali haqida; kundalik tartib haqida gapirish. Talaffuz: o'qilmaydigan harflar
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: agreeing - disagreeing (so/neither/nor)
  = rozi bo'lish va rozi bo'lmaslik
Yozish: Project - yangi qalamkash do'stga xat

⚠ 'a silent letter' = yozilsa ham O'QILMAYDIGAN
harf: 'know', 'write', 'listen'.

points.en: UNIT 3: talking about shopping facilities in a place; talking about a big department store. Pronunciation: /h/
points.uz: 3-UNIT: joydagi savdo imkoniyatlari; katta univermag haqida gapirish. Talaffuz: /h/

points.en: UNIT 4: sounds; sequence of events; telling a story. Pronunciation: sentence stress
points.uz: 4-UNIT: tovushlar; voqealar ketma-ketligi; hikoya aytish. Talaffuz: gap urg'usi
5-UNIT: orzu va rejalar haqida gapirish. Talaffuz: 'll
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: uchrashuv belgilash; eslatish va
  tinchlantirish
Yozish: Project - do'stga xat (yozgi rejalar)

points.en: UNIT 6: making a shopping list; ordering food; advice on kitchen hygiene. Pronunciation: like / 'd like
points.uz: 6-UNIT: xarid ro'yxati; ovqat buyurtma qilish; oshxona gigienasi. Talaffuz: like / 'd like

points.en: UNIT 7: recent changes; taking notes. Pronunciation: /id/
UNIT 9: making enquiries; describing landmarks. Pronunciation: word stress
points.uz: 9-UNIT: so'rov qilish; diqqatga sazovor joylarni tasvirlash. Talaffuz: so'z urg'usi
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: asking for information = ma'lumot so'rash
Yozish: Project - tarixiy joylar haqida ma'lumotnoma

points.en: UNIT 10: rules; warnings; giving instructions. Pronunciation: must/mustn't
points.uz: 10-UNIT: qoidalar; ogohlantirishlar; ko'rsatma berish. Talaffuz: must/mustn't
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: ijobiy/salbiy rozilik
Yozish: Project - xavfsiz sayr varaqasi; yangilik xabari

points.en: UNIT 11: radio programme; environmental problems. Pronunciation: /e/
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: muammoga yechim taklif qilish
Yozish: Project - atrof-muhitni himoya qilish takliflari

points.en: UNIT 12: holiday experiences; holiday resorts; holiday preparations. Pronunciation: words that rhyme
points.uz: 12-UNIT: ta'til tajribalari; dam olish maskanlari; tayyorgarlik. Talaffuz: qofiyalanuvchi so'zlar
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: taklif so'rash va berish
Yozish: Project - dam olish maskanidan otkritkalar

points.en: UNIT 13: festival preparations; comments. Pronunciation: syllable stress
points.uz: 13-UNIT: bayramga tayyorgarlik; fikr bildirish. Talaffuz: bo'g'in urg'usi
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: yo'l ko'rsatish; yoqtirish/yoqtirmaslikni
  bildirish
Yozish: Project - taklifnoma

points.en: UNIT 14: describing animals; making suggestions; identifying animals. Intonation
points.uz: 14-UNIT: hayvonlarni tasvirlash; taklif kiritish; hayvonlarni aniqlash. Ohang
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: uchrashuvni kelishish
Yozish: Project - yo'qolib borayotgan turlar haqida
  ma'lumotnoma; fikr-mulohaza maqolasi

points.en: UNIT 15: taking messages/notes. Intonation in question tags
points.noteUz:
Muloqot: munosabat bildirish; izoh berish
Yozish: Project - Internet xabarlari; bolalar uchun
  Internetning foydasi va zarari haqida maqola
